fields.label: Experience level
fields.note: Client-side tabs in #ghLevels; derived in the browser from years-of-experience text, not a source field.

notes: The open-positions page embeds a client-side Greenhouse renderer over the company-scoped board https://api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/nksecuritiesresearch (jobs?content=true plus /departments). All filtering happens in the browser: #ghSearch is a free-text search over title/location/department labels, #ghLocation is a select, #ghDepartments is a tab group, and #ghLevels is a derived experience tab. No filter is sent to the API, there is no pagination or search request, and the unfiltered board returns all 15 jobs.
